note: FNS 1161 is a QC review procedure section ('Special Treatment of Variances') that instructs QC reviewers on how to handle variances in shelter and utility deductions. Its subsections (1161.2 change reporting, 1161.3 incorrectly processed expenses, 1161.4 monthly reporting failures) define how reviewers should include or exclude variances — not caseworker policy. The underlying policy rules embedded in the section — that change-reporting households must report shelter only when they move, that the agency must explore shelter changes when an address change is reported, and how to handle unreported/unverified expenses — are all thoroughly covered in the OLG. Specifically: 'Change Reporting – Examples' covers the move-and-report requirement with VC-1 procedures; 'Simplified Reporting – Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance' provides detailed address-change procedures including telephonic signature, cold calls, and SUA handling; 'Processing of Unverified Expense Deductions' covers the rule that benefits must be calculated without unverified shelter/utility deductions after an address change. The OLG appropriately translates these rules into worker-actionable procedures without adopting the QC variance framework, which is audit methodology, not caseworker guidance.
